title: Alacrity | Easy Anvils & Easy Magic Support
description: Retexture of Easy Anvils/Magic in Alacrity style
body:
[](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity-easy-anvils-easy-magic-support) [](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/alacrity-easy-anvils-easy-magic-support) ---
An **unofficial compatibility pack** designed to align the aesthetics of [Easy Anvils](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-anvils) and [Easy Magic](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-magic) mods with the [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity) resource pack. This pack is **100% completed**, including: - **Easy Anvils** : Support for "Edit Name Tag" GUI - **Easy Magic** : Support for "Enchanting Table Reroll" GUI **Note:** - Installing both [Easy Anvils](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-anvils) and [Easy Magic](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-magic) is **optional**. It's fine to have only one of them. - For the best experience, use this pack alongside [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity). - For Bug Report / Suggestion, please DM me on my **Discord (@thedatthai)**. **Credits:** - [Satellence](https://modrinth.com/user/Satellence) - Creator of Alacrity - [Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/user/Fuzs) - Creator of Easy Anvils & Easy Magic ## Showcase: ![Showcase (GUI)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd0bcc472b8684a8362b8812bf2e5f87013ca35c.png)
